Package hadur2.core.model

Class BotEvent.RobotDeath

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.model.BotEvent.RobotDeath
All Implemented Interfaces:
BotEvent
Enclosing interface:
BotEvent
public static final class BotEvent.RobotDeath extends Object implements BotEvent
A robot died. In melee it leaves the movement's risk and the gun's targets on the same tick (MSENSE-1); when the duel is fighting one of several opponents, a dead focus is replaced by another.
